author: Partner Threat Feed
attributes.description: Identifies three or more hosts resolving command and control domains used by the Hollow Lectern banking trojan, as reported in campaign PTF-03254. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.
A shared hosting address or domain that later served benign content.
attributes.name: Hollow Lectern Banking Trojan: Several hosts resolving command and control domains (PTF-03254)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Hollow Lectern Banking Trojan: Several hosts resolving command and control domains

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Hollow Lectern banking trojan in campaign PTF-03254.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
attributes.query:
FROM logs-endpoint.events.network-*
| WHERE dns.question.name IN ("cdn-secure96.example", "node-portal6.example", "secure-login20.invalid", "track-cloud5.example")
| STATS host_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.id), hosts = VALUES(host.name) BY dns.question.name
| WHERE host_count >= 3
